Main Page:
'''Mafia''' is an online social deduction game on Scratch, made by Daylight Studios. Everyone gets a secret role. The Mafia strike at night, and everyone else has to work out who they are before it's too late.

== Before you play ==
Mafia is in '''beta'''. You need to be a Scratcher to play, because cloud variables don't work for New Scratchers.

'''Advertising is not allowed.''' It will be deleted and reported.

How to Play:
== Joining a game ==
Join the queue. When 5 players are in it, a 30 second countdown starts. When it reaches zero the game begins and every player gets a secret [[Roles|role]].

== The phases ==
A game moves through four phases, then goes back to the start and repeats.
* '''Intermission''' (15 seconds): a short break before the next night.
* '''Night''' (60 seconds): the [[Mafia (role)|Mafia]] can shoot a player.
* '''Discussion''' (60 seconds): talk it through. The [[Vigilante]] can shoot a player.
* '''Voting''' (30 seconds): vote for a player to eject, or skip.

== Shooting ==
When someone is shot, the player is dead and the phase timer drops to 15 seconds.

== Voting ==
Each living player gets one vote. Your vote is permanent until Voting ends, so choose carefully. If there's a tie, the [[Judge]] breaks it.

Factions:
Every role belongs to one of three factions.

== Mafia ==
Stay hidden and take out everyone else. Roles: [[Mafia (role)|Mafia]], [[Witch]].

== Neutral ==
Has its own goal, separate from the other factions. Roles: [[Jester]].

== Citizens ==
Work out who the Mafia are. Roles: [[Bodyguard]], [[Spy]], [[Vigilante]], [[Doctor]], [[Detective]], [[Ringmaster]], [[Judge]].

Jester:
{{Infobox role
|name=Jester
|faction=[[Factions|Neutral]]
|color=#6b0000
}}
Your goal is to get voted out, so act as suspiciously as you can.

If the Mafia kill you during the night, you lose. If you get voted out, or the [[Vigilante]] shoots you, you win and can bring 1 person with you to the afterlife.

The Jester also wins with the winning team, so if the Mafia win, you win with them.

Judge:
{{Infobox role
|name=Judge
|faction=[[Factions|Citizens]]
|color=#2a8a1a
}}
If there's a tie, you break it. You can silently choose one of the tied players to eject, or skip.

Nobody knows you're the Judge, so your identity stays hidden. You can also see who people voted for, or whether they skipped. Use that to work out who is lying about their role.

Your goal is to figure out who the Mafia are.
